mainEntity.name: What is AI-Augmented Red Team testing?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI-Augmented Red Team testing simulates attack paths where AI systems are the target, the weapon, or both. It covers AI supply chain attack simulation against ML pipelines, LLM/agent red teaming including prompt injection and jailbreaks, deepfake-based vishing and BEC simulation, and AI-accelerated recon benchmarking, going beyond traditional network and human-focused red teaming.

mainEntity.name: Does ISECURION deliver AI-Augmented Red Team engagements outside India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ISECURION delivers AI-Augmented Red Team engagements globally, including the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar), Singapore, and Australia, through a mix of remote engagement and on-site delivery, coordinated across time zones by a dedicated engagement lead.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from a traditional red team engagement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional red teams test human and network attack paths - phishing, network pivoting, physical access. AI-Augmented Red Team specifically tests AI-native attack surfaces: ML training/inference pipelines, LLM guardrails and tool-calling agents, and AI-generated social engineering like deepfake voice cloning.

mainEntity.name: Can we run just one module, or do we need the full suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each of the four modules - Supply Chain Attack Simulation, LLM/Agent Red Teaming, Deepfake Vishing/BEC Simulation, and AI-Accelerated Recon Benchmark - can be scoped and priced standalone. Bundling two or more modules earns a discount, and the full suite is available at a flat package price.

mainEntity.name: Can this be added to an existing VAPT or RTaaS retainer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. AI-Augmented Red Team is designed to sell as a standalone engagement or as an add-on module to an existing VAPT/RTaaS retainer, anywhere in the world, and individual modules can be scoped independently based on your AI footprint.

mainEntity.name: Is the deepfake vishing simulation legal and ethical across jurisdictions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Deepfake voice or video content is only created and used with documented consent from the impersonated individual, under signed rules of engagement tailored to local law in the client's jurisdiction, and destroyed after the engagement per agreed retention terms.

mainEntity.name: How does this align with data protection rules like GDPR or DPDP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scoping and rules of engagement are adapted to the relevant data protection framework for the client's jurisdiction - including GDPR in Europe, DPDP in India, and equivalent frameworks in the GCC, Singapore, and Australia - so that test data handling, consent, and retention comply with local requirements.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AI-Augmented Red Team engagement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard engagements run 3-5 weeks depending on the number of modules selected and environment complexity, covering scoping, reconnaissance, execution, detection validation, and reporting - regardless of the client's location.
